name: Angus
title: Grand Master

villagemaster/30474.htm.text: Grand Master Angus: Who would you be, then? Did the will of Shilen guide you to this place? I am Angus, a humble servant of Shilen tasked with teaching Dark Elves.

links.text: Listen to information about second class transfer.

Q00138_TempleChampionPart2/30474-01.html.text: Grand Master Angus: (Angus looks very sad...) Hmm... You wish to help me? Well then... One of the Dark Elven trainees was accidentally killed during an actual fighting drill in Death Pass. I am preparing a ritual that will permit his soul to return to Shilen in peace. I do this in accord with the c…

links.text: "Every race has its own customs. I have faced dangers and lost friends as well, and I am touched by your sorrow. I will help you if I can."

Q00138_TempleChampionPart2/30474-04.html.text: Grand Master Angus: You have returned with all of this belongings! Shilen be praised! Thanks to your help, we will be able to send the soul of the dead Dark Elven trainee to rest with Shilen. We are in your debt. I will write you a letter of recommendation so that others of my faith will not treat …

Q00138_TempleChampionPart2/30474-03.html.text: Grand Master Angus: Hurry! Please go to Death Pass and hunt Wyrms, Guardian Basilisks, Road Scavengers and Fettered Souls . Bring back 10 Relics of the Dark Elven Trainee .

Q00138_TempleChampionPart2/30474-05.html.text: Grand Master Angus: You are looking for Preacher Sla? Take my letter of recommendation to Priest Pupina .

Q00138_TempleChampionPart2/30474-02.html.text: Grand Master Angus: Oh! You are very different, I see, from those arrogant priests of the Temple of Einhasad. Thank you! Please go to Death Pass and defeat Wyrms, Guardian Basilisks, Road Scavengers and Fettered Souls . Bring back 10 Relics of the Dark Elven Trainee .
